title: The Separating Noether Number of Finite Abelian Groups
summary: For a finite abelian group $G$, let $β_{\mathrm{sep}}(G)$ denote its separating Noether number. We determine $β_{\mathrm{sep}}(G)$ exactly for every finite abelian group $ G \cong C_{n_1}\oplus \cdots \oplus C_{n_r}$ with $ 1<n_1 \mid \cdots \mid n_r. $ If $r=2s-1$, then $$ β_{\mathrm{sep}}(G)=n_s+n_{s+1}+\cdots+n_r, $$ whereas if $r=2s$, then $$ β_{\mathrm{sep}}(G)=\frac{n_s}{p_1}+n_{s+1}+\cdots+n_r, $$ where $p_1$ denotes the smallest prime divisor of $n_1$. Our proof is additive-combinatorial in nature. It avoids the Davenport-equality assumption $\mathsf{D}(n_sG)=\mathsf{D}^{*}(n_sG)$…
